feedback.end: Flamingos are wading birds that are known for their pink colour. The strength of their colour depends on how many shrimp they eat. If they stop eating shrimp, they will turn a white colour.
Flamingos are omnivores and use their beaks to eat shrimp, algae, insects and small fish. These foods are common in their habitat in North and South America.
Flamingos like to live near salty lakes. They catch their food by standing in the shallow water, dipping their head in and sweeping from side to side.

atoms.feedback: They are only pink when they get enough nutrients from their food.

atoms.a: Flamingos like to catch their food from shallow, salty water.
